Keep searching after a driver is found
Off by default. When on, RideMate tells you if a much closer driver turns up, and changes nothing unless you say yes.

Keeping more than one booking means drivers may drive towards you and then be cancelled, which costs them time and fuel. Ride apps may also charge a cancellation fee (up to ₹100 under India\'s rules). Turn this on only if you\'ll cancel extra bookings quickly.
RideMate\'s owner can switch features off remotely if a ride app changes. When AI reading is off, you type prices and the guardian keeps working.
